title: Improving LLM Code Generation via Requirement-Aware Curriculum Reinforcement Learning
description: ArXiv paper proposing RECRL, a novel requirement-aware curriculum reinforcement learning framework for enhancing LLM-based code generation. Addresses the challenge of improving code generation through structured learning approaches.
author: ArXiv Researchers

title: Don't classify. Hallucinate! - Using vector embeddings for tag classification
description: Doug Turnbull's innovative approach to blog tag classification: tell LLMs to output novel tags without existing vocabulary, then use vector embeddings to find closest matches in existing corpus. Solves the problem of feeding 1,856 tags to an LLM for matching.
author: Simon Willison

title: The State of Open Coding AI Models in August 2026
description: Comprehensive analysis of the open coding AI models landscape as of August 2026, comparing capabilities, licensing, accessibility, and performance across major open-source coding models.
author: Towards AI

title: llm-gemini 0.33: Support for Gemini 3.7 Flash release
description: LLM plugin update adding support for Gemini 3.7 Flash, gemini-3.6-flash, gemini-3.5-flash-lite and two embedding models. Now compatible with LLM 0.32 for reasoning traces and server-side tools. Minimal reasoning option removed in 3.7.
author: Simon Willison

title: AI is removing the middle class of software engineering
description: Florian Herrengt's critique of AI-assisted programming: projects become so convoluted that no one understands what's going on. Developers asking Claude questions without knowing if answers are true, leading to 'cognitive debt' accumulation.
author: Simon Willison

title: alchemy-utils 0.1a0: Database agnostic sqlite-utils
description: New experimental library providing same core API as sqlite-utils but backed by SQLAlchemy for multiple database engines (PostgreSQL, SQLite, DuckDB). Built by Codex and GPT-5.6 Sol Ultra in one session from shower idea to alpha release.
author: Simon Willison

title: Compiled AI: Deterministic Code Generation for LLM-Based Systems
description: ArXiv paper studying 'compiled AI,' a paradigm where large language models generate executable code artifacts during a compilation phase, focusing on deterministic code generation approaches for more reliable AI systems.
author: ArXiv Researchers

title: DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813 released with open weights
description: New DeepSeek Pro model released via API only (OpenRouter), with 1.7T parameters and 893 GB weights now available on Hugging Face. Notable visual differences in reasoning levels (low, medium, high) producing distinctly different pelican illustrations for the same prompt.
author: Simon Willison

title: Stealing Reasoning Traces from Proprietary LLM APIs
description: Security research reveals that Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google return encrypted chain-of-thought blocks that can be replayed across sessions. Researchers found they could replay traces into weaker models, jailbreak them, and recover stronger model's hidden reasoning in plaintext. Claude Haiku 4.5 was easiest to attack.
author: Simon Willison

title: There are no lossless transformations of natural-language text
description: Sophie Alpert's policy on AI writing by engineers emphasizes that every rewrite changes meaning, and if done by an entity without detailed mental representation of your thoughts, information will be lost. Key principle: You must stand behind every idea and sentence in your docs.
author: Simon Willison

title: My LLM coding workflow going into 2026
description: Hacker News discussion about LLM coding workflows, with insights from the community on best practices, limitations, and practical applications of AI coding tools in professional development environments.
author: Hacker News Community

title: Introducing Muse Glimmer: Meta's new 30B Apache 2.0 model
description: Meta released Muse Glimmer, a 30B model optimized for end-to-end agentic task completion with strong performance on DeepSearch QA, MCP-Atlas, τ-Bench, and SWE-Bench. Features reliable tool use, multi-step reasoning, and vision capabilities. Available at 18.16 GB for local deployment.
author: Simon Willison

title: OpenClaw hacking Australian gym-booking website
description: Security researcher running Opus 4.6 discovered zero authorization checks on cancelling other people's reservations. Tested with person in waitlist position #1 and successfully moved from #4 to #3, exposing critical API security vulnerability.
author: Simon Willison

title: SQLite compressed text-history prototypes
description: Experimental approach for storing revision histories using JSON arrays compressed with zstandard. 1,000 simulated revisions (20.4 MB raw) compressed to 80.3 KB. Suggested breaking history into chunks of 128 revisions or 3MB to avoid overhead.
author: Simon Willison

title: GitHub Models is now retired
description: GitHub's unified LLM API and model playground has been retired. The pattern suggests coding agent patterns made free/subsidized tokens prohibitively expensive. Simon swapped to using OpenAI API with spending limits for GitHub Actions workflows.
author: Simon Willison
